text:
amy_sales: Quick sync needed. Prospect (FinNova) wants a 48h POC: BYO-HSM + Redwood proxy fallback. Theyre asking about rotation runbooks and whether POC usage can be applied to a Dedicated commit.
tom_se: I can draft the runbook. Key Qs: will they run HSM in persistent attach or only as key provider during rotation?
cust_sec: We'll attach HSM persistently in prod, but for POC we'll use proxy mode. Need to validate: 5k ops/sec encrypt, 99th pct <200ms incl. network.
nikhil_eng: We should run two scenarios: A) proxy-only with mutual TLS B) hybrid where we cache KEKs for N secs. For caching we have config `cache_ttl_ms`. Recommend 60000 for safety.
amy_sales: What about billing when they hit the proxy a lot during the POC? Theyre worried about surprise metered charges.
infra_bot: Billing note: Proxy HSM egress is metered per-op. Sales-approved dry-runs can be zero-rated up to an ops cap if Sales Ops flags the trial ID.
nikhil_eng: For rotation: propose staged rotation script: 1) create new CMK in customer HSM 2) push new key metadata to Redwood via admin API 3) enable `dual_write=true` for 5 min 4) promote new key and monitor decrypt errors.
amy_sales: Can we show them an example admin API call?
tom_se: Example (curl): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/v1/keys/import \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer @admin_token' \
 -F 'key=@cmk.pem' \
 -F 'metadata={"owner":"finnova","env":"poc"}'
```
cust_sec: We also need attestation proof. Do you provide HSM attestation chain + timestamped logs?
nikhil_eng: Yes. We'll export attestation statements and rotation events. Sample log line: "{\"ts\":\"2026-04-02T09:12:06Z\",\"evt\":\"cmk_import\",\"id\":\"cmk-fn-02\",\"attestation_chain\":\"-----BEGIN...\"}"
legal_eve: For SOW: include attestation retention (90 days default), log export format (JSONL), and incident notification SLA for key integrity events. Also add carve-outs: upstream HSM provider outages excluded.
amy_sales: Sales Ops question: If POC to Dedicated conversion happens within 30 days, can we credit metered POC usage toward first-month commit?
infra_bot: Policy: credit is discretionary. Submit a POCR (POC Credit Request) with trial_id + usage report; finance will review.
tom_se: Ops checklist: firewall egress CIDRs, mTLS cert bundle, sample `kms-bench` run. Sample bench command: ```bash
./kms-bench --url https://proxy.finnova.redwood --clients 250 --duration 600
```
cust_sec: We'll need a failback policy. If new key fails, traffic should automatically hit previous key for 3 minutes. Is that configurable?
nikhil_eng: Yes, `fallback_window_ms` configurable. We'll set 180000ms for the POC and log every fallback event.
amy_sales: Action items: @nikhil_eng provide bench binary + attestation samples; @tom_se draft runbook; @amy_sales open POCR and request credit; @cust_sec send firewall list by Tue EOD.
legal_eve: I'll draft the SOW paragraph for attestation & carve-outs and share in a doc.
amy_sales: Thanks all. Reopen if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
